rules.text: No returns will be accepted after 30 days from date of purchase.
rules.quote: No returns will be accepted after 30 days from date of purchase.

rules.text: All returns require proof of purchase.
rules.quote: All returns require proof of purchase.

rules.text: Refunds will be made to the original form of payment.
rules.quote: Refunds will be made to the original form of payment.

rules.text: Apparel or shoes must be returned unworn and with tags attached.
rules.quote: Apparel or shoes must be returned unworn and with tags attached.

rules.text: Alcoholic beverages are subject to state and/or local restrictions.
rules.quote: Alcoholic beverages are subject to state and/or local restrictions.

rules.text: Gift cards sold at Whole Foods Market cannot be returned or redeemed for cash or credit.
rules.quote: Gift cards sold at Whole Foods Market cannot be returned or redeemed for cash or credit.

rules.text: Only products purchased at a Whole Foods Market store or wholefoodsmarket.com are eligible for return.
rules.quote: Only products purchased at a Whole Foods Market store or wholefoodsmarket.com are eligible for return.

rules.text: WIC purchases cannot lawfully be returned but may be exchanged for identical food items if defective, spoiled or out of code at time of sale.
rules.quote: WIC purchases cannot lawfully be returned but may be exchanged for identical food items if the product is defective, spoiled or was out of code at the time of sale.

rules.text: Refunds will be made in the form of a Merchandise Return Card for returns using a gift receipt or purchases originally made using Campus Card.
rules.quote: Refunds will be made in the form of a Merchandise Return Card for returns using a gift receipt or purchases originally made using Campus Card.

rules.text: Whole Foods Market reserves the right to deny returns, refunds and exchanges including preventing fraud, suspected fraud or abuse.
rules.quote: Whole Foods Market reserves the right to deny returns, refunds and exchanges including, but not limited to, preventing fraud, suspected fraud or abuse.
